page.overview:
Who is George Connor?

George Connor (born 16 August 1906 and died 28 March 2001) was an American racecar driver who participated in 14 Indianapolis 500 races from 1935 to 1952. His entries from to were included in the Formula One championship, but his best finish was third place the year prior.
